# Simplified Chinese characters that Japanese text cannot hold (not in code page 932), as Unicode code points in hex,
# for bench/stray_words.ps1's simp count. From the list manoreken2 posted on issue #4 (SimplifiedChineseChars.txt,
# 1,094 lines), keeping only the characters CP932 cannot encode (5 of the list are in CP932 and dropped). Rare
# characters that Japanese and Chinese share but CP932 lacks (U+90A2, U+6C10) are not in it: stray_words counts those as
# rare. One line: 16 code points.
